_: Identity system MVP (sub-project B): a lightweight class/identity system. Each identity = a FACT (held signal) + priority + optional grants/acquire. THREE FACES: Acquire (read a tome → MFIdentityBook OnRead joins the faction + grants an ability + plays a scene), Grant (a standing Fortify ability while you hold the identity), Gate (identity/primaryIdentity dialogue tags → GetInFaction CTDA so NPCs treat you by your identity). Headline: the Paladin oath reuses the just-shipped PlayIdle scene-action (an oath-keeper BOWS and blesses you). Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-06-identity-system-design.md.

magicEffects.name: Oath of the Eight
magicEffects.description: Your oath steadies your sword arm.
magicEffects._: A constant-effect Fortify One-Handed: the Paladin's standing grant. ValueModifier/OneHanded, ConstantEffect/Self, Recover flag so the bonus is restored (not a one-shot). Detrimental NOT set (it's a buff).

spells.name: Oath of the Eight
spells._: The Paladin's standing ability (spellType=Ability, ConstantEffect/Self). Granted on join, removed on leave by MFIdentityBook. +20 One-Handed while held — check in-game with `player.getav onehanded` or the Active Effects menu.

books.name: Oath of the Eight Divines
books._: Reading it (MFIdentityBook OnRead, attached automatically via identities[].acquireBook) joins MF_FactPaladin, grants MF_AbilSmite, and starts the oath scene.
books.text: Kneel, and swear: my blade to the weak, my breath to the Eight. Read these words to take the oath.

books.name: Trader's Ledger
books._: A TOGGLE identity: reading it joins MF_FactMerchant; reading it again leaves it.
books.text: Mark your goods, tally your coin. Read to take up the trade — or read again to set it down.

classes.name: ModForge Townsfolk
classes._: REQUIRED for the NPCs: autoCalcStats derives H/M/S from the class+level. WITHOUT a class the calc yields ~0 health and an essential NPC spawns in permanent bleedout (looks dead — you'd have to `resurrect` it). Health-weighted so they have real HP.

npcs.name: Oath-Keeper
npcs.greeting: Speak your oath when you are ready.

quests._: Host quest for the oath scene + the identity-gated dialogue. StartGameEnabled so both are live.
quests.name: ModForge Identity Showcase

scenes._: Started by MF_PaladinTome's OnRead (AcquireScene.Start()). The scene-level condition (player already in MF_FactPaladin) keeps it from auto-playing at game load — Start() bypasses begin-conditions, so the book still fires it. The oath-keeper BOWS (PlayIdle, reuses scene-playidle) and blesses you.

lines: Rise, sworn of the Eight. Your blade is theirs now.

responses: Well met, paladin. The Eight smile on you.
A fellow trader, well met. Coin to coin.
